en-US.description: An AI-powered input method with voice recognition, smart suggestions, and cross-device copy and paste.
en-US.longDescription: Doubao Input Method is the PC AI input method from Doubao. It delivers voice recognition comparable to Doubao, supporting dialects, mixed Chinese and English speech, and technical terms with noise-robust and whisper-level input. Large-model capabilities add smart suggestions, long-sentence completion, and correction while typing, spoken input can be automatically reorganized into polished text, and features such as cross-device copy and paste are included.

zh-CN.description: 高效输入、享受输出的 AI 输入法，支持语音识别、中英混输、智能纠错与跨设备复制粘贴。
zh-CN.longDescription: 豆包输入法是豆包推出的 PC 端 AI 输入法。它提供媲美豆包的语音识别能力，支持方言识别、中英混说与技术术语，具备抗噪和轻声输入能力；结合大模型能力实现智能联想、长句补全与边打字边纠错，还能将口语化表达自动整理成通顺文字，并提供超级互传等跨设备复制粘贴体验。
